artifacts.summary: Comprehensive 1231-line research report on building a forward-chaining proof generation system for bimodal logic TM. The report (1) analyzes the existing ProofSystem (42 axiom schemata, DerivationTree inductive with 7 rules, height function) in Axioms.lean and Derivation.lean, (2) examines the existing DatasetGenerator pipeline (exhaustive enumeration → decide → label with ProofTrace/RuleProfile), (3) cross-references task 277's ProofCertificate / TraceEntry infrastructure, (4) reviews literature on DeepSeek-Prover-V2 subgoal decomposition, SynLogic (NeurIPS 2025) parameterized generation, and Libal & Volpe (2016) FPC, (5) designs a forward-chaining algorithm that generalizes generateValidBatch (FormulaEnumerator.lean:1361) to track DerivationTree witnesses, with bounded depth, O(n) modus ponens via implication index, ex_falso cap, and dedup by shortest-height, (6) provides a concrete Lean 4 sketch for ForwardProofGenerator.lean, ProofFirstExporter.lean, and ProofFirstBenchmark.lean, (7) defines per-proof and per-corpus metrics (axiom diversity, proof depth distribution, temporal axiom usage), and (8) recommends architecture: 3 GenerationMode variants (exhaustive/proofFirst/hybrid) dispatched in labelFormula, with a new CLI executable proof_first_generator. Key finding: every (formula, DerivationTree) pair emitted is a theorem by construction (Lean type system IS the verifier); expected ~37x improvement in valid-formula throughput vs. exhaustive enumeration at c4.

key_findings: DerivationTree is the right supervision signal: 7 constructors (axiom, assumption, modus_ponens, necessitation, temporal_necessitation, temporal_duality, weakening) parameterized by FrameClass, with a computable height function. No new inductive type needed.

The existing generateValidBatch in FormulaEnumerator.lean:1361-1461 is the closest existing forward-generation code, but it discards the proof trees — task 279 must thread DerivationTree witnesses through the same fixpoint closure (MP / Nec / TempNec / TempDual).

instantiateAxiom (FormulaEnumerator.lean:1153) covers 22 schemata but the current Axiom type has 42 constructors (Axioms.lean:18-37). Extending instantiateAxiom to all 42 and returning Axiom witnesses is a necessary prerequisite.
Modus ponens explosion is solved by the implication index pattern at FormulaEnumerator.lean:1430-1448 (HashMap from Formula.lhs to Array of (rhs, proof)): O(n) per MP round instead of O(n^2).

Task 277's ProofCertificate.axiomFingerprint (TraceCertificate.lean:122) is the *tableau*-side axiom counts; task 279 produces *Hilbert*-side AxiomProfile. They are complementary views of the same formula, not duplicates.

Soundness is enforced by Lean's type system: every emitted d : DerivationTree fc [] phi carries an Axiom witness at leaves, and the only way to combine is via the 7 inference rule constructors. No separate verifier needed (SynLogic-style construction-rule guarantee, strictly stronger).

Frame class compatibility: DerivationTree.axiom's h_fc : h.minFrameClass <= fc field is decidable. Two sound options: (1) runtime decide() at instantiation time, (2) generate at .Base and lift to .Dense/.Discrete via DerivationTree.lift (Derivation.lean:190). Recommendation: filter schema list at instantiateAxiomWithProof time.
Ex_falso cap of 20% (mirroring EnumBenchmark.lean:79) is a hard requirement; the capExFalso logic at FormulaEnumerator.lean:1389-1417 is reusable.
Dedup strategy: shortest-wins (by DerivationTree.height) is recommended; one canonical proof per formula simplifies downstream training (one label per formula).
Weakening rule should NOT be applied in forward generation: it adds unused assumptions without changing the conclusion, producing log-equivalent duplicates under empty context. Skip it.
Expected performance: depth=2, seed=2000, atoms=[p,q,r] generates ~750-1000 valid theorems in ~5 seconds — ~37x more efficient per valid formula than exhaustive c4 (408 formulas, ~20 valid).

Per-corpus metrics (axiom diversity, proof depth distribution, temporal axiom usage, ex_falso dominance) are aggregations over existing LabeledFormula fields (proofTrace, ruleProfile, interestingnessScore, patternKey) — no new per-proof extractors needed.
recommendations: Reuse DerivationTree as the proof representation; do not introduce a new inductive type. The 4 existing termination/soundness proofs in Derivation.lean (height, lift, mp_height_gt_*, weakening_height_succ) are preserved unchanged.

Implement forwardGenerate in a new Theories/Bimodal/Automation/ForwardProofGenerator.lean with: (1) ForwardConfig structure, (2) ProofPool with HashSet+Array+HashMap dedup-by-shortest, (3) instantiateAxiomWithProof covering all 42 axiom constructors and returning Sigma phi, DerivationTree, (4) applyModusPonens using implication index for O(n) closure, (5) Bounded fixpoint loop over (modus_ponens, necessitation, temporal_necessitation, temporal_duality), (6) capExFalso at 20%.
Add GenerationMode inductive (exhaustive | proofFirst | hybrid) to DatasetGenerator.lean, dispatch in labelFormula. Hybrid mode runs both and merges by interestingnessTier then by proofTrace.height.
Extend instantiateAxiom in FormulaEnumerator.lean from 22 to 42 cases, returning Sigma (phi, Axiom phi) for use by the forward generator's instantiateAxiomWithProof.

Add new CLI executable lake exe proof_first_generator in lakefile.lean, mirroring dataset_generator and trace_exporter. JSONL output: one record per (formula, proof) with decisionMethod="proof_first".

Per-corpus metrics in a new ProofFirstBenchmark.lean: axiom_diversity, proof_depth_distribution, temporal_axiom_usage, modal_axiom_usage, rule_profile_distribution, ex_falso_dominance, operator_diversity, generation_cost.

For frame class: filter schema list at instantiateAxiomWithProof time, not at DerivationTree.axiom construction time. This avoids runtime decide() calls and makes the type system enforce compatibility.

For the comparison methodology (task requirement #6), run both exhaustive (c4, modal 2, temporal 2, atoms 3) and proof-first (maxDepth 2, seed 500, atoms 3) modes, then emit a side-by-side JSON comparison report with the 8 cross-corpus metrics.
Defer full DerivationTree JSON serialization to a future task; the existing ProofTrace summary (height, axiom names, rule names) is sufficient for ML training.
Defer hybrid-mode + decideWithTrace integration to round 2; the core forward generator is complete without it. Round 2 adds a tableauTrace : Option ProofCertificate field to LabeledFormula.
